# Inflation, consumer prices for the US (FPCPITOTLZGUSA) | FRED. ### Inflation, consumer prices for the United States (FPCPITOTLZGUSA) | FRED. The source code outlining how this product gathers, transforms, revises and publishes its datasets is available at . The dataset file included with this product is provided in CSV format. The included dataset contains the following columns: DATE, FPCPITOTLZGUSA. This dataset contains a historical time-series data of Inflation, consumer prices for the United States (FPCPITOTLZGUSA) starting from 1960-01-01. The values within the data field labeled FPCPITOTLZGUSA represents inflation in the US as the consumer price index in Percent at the time of the corresponding DATE field. This dataset is provided by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis Economic Data (FRED).
